appearance.subtle: Their features are hard to fix in your memory.
appearance.obvious: Their face is not the face they had when you came in, and they do not appear to have done it on purpose.
appearance.extreme: They are rebuilding themselves as you watch. Bone slides, skin re-textures, and they settle into a shape with too many joints and regard you with eyes that were a different colour a moment ago.

description: The rarest thing the Wildblood have. Your morphology has come under conscious control, more or less. You can decide, for a while, what you are.
name: Metamorphic Body
